positive_snippets: Located near Delhi Airport, this place is very convenient for an overnight stay. The room is spacious, clean, and quite comfortable. The bathroom is also clean, though the absence of a shower curtain means water tends to splash all over the floor. The food is pretty decent, and the service is quite good. The staff are friendly and welcoming, which adds to the overall pleasant experience.
Great hotel with great service.  Complimentary breakfast.  Good air conditioning and balcony from our bedroom
Comfortable stay with affordable rates. Nice location. Staff behaviour is too good and helpful. Very satisfied staying here
